outputs.display_value: X = cyclo[V–L]₆, where V = OHC–C₆H₃[–p-C₆H₄–NH–]₂ and L = –C(O)–C₆F₄–C(O)–. The smallest repeat is one V–L pair, C₂₇H₁₄F₄N₂O₃; the six formyl groups point outward.
outputs.raw_value: V=OHC-C6H3[-p-C6H4-NH-]2 and L=-C(O)-C6F4-C(O)-. Six alternating V and L components form cyclo[V-L]6; each L connects N_i-C(O)-C6F4-C(O)-N_(i+1). The least positive component period is [V,L], whose exact molecular formula is C27H14F4N2O3.
